mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits UGT1A1-mediated glucuronidation and may increase rilpivirine levels, while rilpivirine's acidic properties may displace valproate from protein binding, potentially increasing valproate toxicity.
action: Monitor rilpivirine and valproate plasma concentrations closely; consider alternative antiretroviral or anticonvulsant therapy; if co-administration is necessary, adjust dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
